answer: I would stop farms with light client proof of Solana state, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Cloning 754 keys multiplies the price 754-fold: 82940 POA locked, or 13572 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One orchard of signal, one yarrow of cost, one raven of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
